hook.text: Amazon earned $11 billion in US profit in 2018 and paid zero federal income tax.

buildup.text: Amazon carried forward losses from its early unprofitable years.

discovery.text: Combined with accelerated depreciation on massive warehouse investments and stock compensation deductions.

twist.text: Amazon wasn't cheating—it was using provisions Congress designed to encourage investment and risk-taking.

climax.text: Amazon's zero-tax years showed that a company can be enormously profitable and legally owe nothing.

punchline.text: $11 billion profit, $129 million refund. Congress designed it this way.

quiz.question: How did Amazon pay zero federal tax on $11 billion in profit?
options: Loss carryforwards, depreciation, and stock compensation deductions
